meta.title: Nivasa · Homes by Company A, Ahmedabad
meta.description: Two RERA-registered residential projects in Ahmedabad. Ask anything at any hour and book a site visit in a free slot.

home.title: A home that feels like yours.
home.lead: Two RERA-registered projects in west Ahmedabad. Ask anything, at any hour, in English, Hindi or Gujarati, and book a site visit in a slot that is actually free.
home.step1Body: Answers come only from the registered project fact sheet. If something isn't there, a person will confirm it.
home.step2Body: Pick a free slot. You'll get a reminder a day before and again two hours before.
home.step3Body: A named member of our sales team meets you at the site office.
home.personBody: Ask for a person at any point in the chat and a member of our sales team will call you.

footer.priceNote: Prices are indicative and exclude government charges. The final price for a home is confirmed by our sales team.

slots.none: No free slots in the next two weeks. Ask us and a person will find a time.
slots.weekLead: Every time shown is free right now. Pick one to book.

privacy.title: How we use your details
privacy.p1: We collect your name, mobile number and what you tell us about the home you want, so we can answer your questions and arrange site visits.
privacy.p2: We contact you on WhatsApp, SMS or a call only about your enquiry, and only after you agree. Reply STOP to any message, or use My visits, to stop messages at any time.
privacy.p3: Your details are stored in India and seen only by the sales team handling your enquiry. Every time a staff member opens your record, it is logged.
privacy.p4: To see, correct or delete your details, ask in the chat or tell your sales executive. We will act on it within 7 days.
